properties.name: Coast & Geology
properties.start: Kiu Tsui Public Pier 桥咀公众码头
properties.finish: Same pier, back along the shore
properties.tidal: Critical. Crossing only when tidal height is below 1.25 m. On the survey date the board gave an emergence window of 08:00–10:00 only (p04).
properties.evidence: p02 shows a partly submerged shingle bar at 11:23; p04 shows the 08:00–10:00 emergence window for 13 Nov 2026. Together they explain why this route is tide-dependent and why our group stayed on the main island.

properties.name: Shaded Ridge & Hap Mun Bay
properties.start: Kiu Tsui Beach 桥咀泳滩
properties.finish: Hap Mun Bay Beach 厦门湾泳滩
properties.shade: 2 of 5 stops mostly or partly shaded; viewpoint and beach unshaded
properties.tidal: No tidal crossing required — the route stays on the main island.
properties.evidence: p09–p15 show a closed canopy and dappled shade at 12:38–12:51, while p17 and p21–p25 show an open, unshaded ridge from 12:52. p18 and p19 document erosion and hand-built steps, and p20 supplies the signposted distances and walking times.
